data.title: 焰影苇草 · 茶叶的香气
data.description: 她先温好茶壶，再放入茶叶。热水倒进去时，淡淡的香气慢慢散开。
data.promptProse: Seated at a low wooden table in a sunroom, Reed uses a carved bamboo scoop to measure dried herbal tea leaves into an ivory porcelain pot. An open ceramic caddy and a gently steaming kettle scent the air with sweet herb and roasted leaf aromas.
data.animaCaption: As boiling water meets the dried leaves in the teapot, she leans close to inhale the rising fragrant steam with a soft, peaceful expression.
